service_boundary: Represents Mistral AI Studio, formerly La Plateforme, not Le Chat, open-weight downloads, self-deployed models, or partner-served Mistral endpoints.
regional_controls: Deployment and residency commitments vary between the hosted platform, enterprise arrangements, and partner-served deployments; the reviewed public docs do not support one universal region claim.
retention_controls: Data handling depends on account tier, feature, and governing commercial terms; stateful platform features must be reviewed separately from stateless model calls.
routing: Customers select models in the Mistral-hosted catalog; partner-served deployments are a distinct contractual path.
customization: Fine-tuning and agent-building paths are documented for eligible models and accounts.
strengths: A European-operated direct platform spans proprietary and open model families.
The platform includes model APIs, tuning, OCR, audio, and agent services.
tradeoffs: The broad platform includes features with different storage behavior.
Partner-hosted and customer-infrastructure deployments have separate terms and boundaries.
